description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tidus
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Blitz Ace (0~2), removed after using Apex Blitz Ace two times

description.name: Apex Blitz Ace Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Blitz Ace level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Water abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tidus]

description.name: Apex Blitz Ace Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Blitz Ace level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Tidus]
